discussion: The use of secure-by-design and secure-by-default principles, memory-safe programming languages (such as C#, Go, Java, Ruby, Rust and Swift), and secure programming practices (supported by agile software development practices, threat modelling and mitigation of common security risks) is an important part of secure software design and development. In addition, providing mechanisms to assist in determining the authenticity and integrity of applications, while configuring them in a secure manner, can assist with software supply chain security activities.
title: The Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) Mobile Application Security Verification Standard is used in the development of mobile applications.
